title: README: add HISTOR MCP tool-definition history
body:
Adds [HISTOR](https://histor.modelmarket.dev/datasets/) under Related datasets, alongside the RugSnare corpus. HISTOR tracks remote MCP tool definitions over time and also observes npm/PyPI package versions in a sandbox. This complements the study's findings on version pins by covering changes in what remote servers actually serve.

I maintain HISTOR; the dataset is available under CC BY 4.0.

Validation: documentation-only change; adds one related-dataset entry.
